🎨 PixelArt

A digital canvas divided into a grid where you place colored pixels to create art. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Select a color from the palette.
  2. Click on grid cells to fill them with the selected color.
  3. Click and drag to paint multiple cells quickly.
  4. Use the eraser or background color to undo mistakes.
  5. Toggle a grid overlay to help with alignment.
